title: BREAKING: Roberto Mata Jr. Arrested on Third-Degree Felony Drug Charge
excerpt: BREAKING: Roberto Mata Jr. was arrested Friday at 10:24 p.m. on an alleged third-degree felony charge of possessing a controlled substance (Penalty Group 1/1-B, 1 gram to under 4 grams). Bond has not been set. An arrest is an allegation; Mata is presumed innocent.
content:
LAREDO, Texas — Roberto Mata Jr. was arrested Friday, November 20, 2026, at 10:24 p.m., and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged third-degree felony charge of possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 1/1-B, in an amount of 1 gram to under 4 grams, according to Webb County booking records reviewed Friday night.

The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record. Mata was booked into the county jail on the single felony charge.

No bond had been set on the charge as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956.

A third-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 10 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Roberto Mata Jr. is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

Webb Watch 956
